usage: 一公里 is used to measure distance and refers to one kilometre, which is 1000 metres.
It can be used in both formal and informal contexts when talking about length or distance.
When giving directions, 一公里 helps specify how far a place is.
It can be combined with verbs like '行' (walk) or '駛' (drive) to describe how far someone walks or drives.
In conversations, 一公里 can also be used metaphorically to indicate a unit of measure in other contexts.

examples.jyutping: paau2 jat1 gung1 lei5 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 joek3 ng5 fan1 zung1.
